info.title: MyPreflight postcard generator
info.description:
A DigitalOcean Function that draws a minimalist flat-vector travel poster for a city with the OpenAI image API and stores it in DigitalOcean Spaces under a uuid the caller chooses.

Deployed as a functions component of the `mypreflight` App Platform app. Every request must carry the `X-Require-Whisk-Auth` header declared as `webSecure` in project.yml; the platform rejects the request before the function runs otherwise.

**The function answers `202` and draws in the background.** A render takes tens of seconds and sometimes minutes, far longer than the platform will hold a synchronous web invocation open, so the request is validated, handed to a second activation and acknowledged at once. The answer carries the `key` and `url` the art will appear at — the caller chose the uuid, so the location is known before the render starts — and the caller polls the bucket for it. Nothing but a `400` tells the caller anything is wrong with the request itself; a render that fails later is only visible as art that never appears.

`200` with a full result is the exception, not the rule: it is answered when the function could not hand the render off and drew it while the caller waited. The image never travels in either answer, because a function result may not exceed 1 MB.

get.summary: Draw a travel poster for a city
get.description: Renders the city with the poster brief, stores the image in Spaces as `<prefix><uuid>.<ext>` and returns the key and url it landed under together with the prompt and render settings. Identical render requests are served from an in-memory cache for a day, for as long as the function instance stays warm, so a second uuid for the same city reuses the drawing and is only stored again.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City to draw. Latin script only, at most 64 characters and 5 words: the value is interpolated into the prompt, so anything sentence-shaped is refused before an image is paid for.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country the city is in, in English. Latin script only, at most 64 characters and 8 words. Settles which city is meant where the name is shared with cities elsewhere and grounds the regional architecture and landscape; it is never drawn as text, a flag, an emblem or a country code.

parameters.name: continent
parameters.description: Continent the city is on, in English. Read case-insensitively. Grounds the terrain, vegetation, climate and quality of light; like the country it is never drawn as text or as a symbol.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Names the object in the bucket. The caller chooses it, so the location is known before the render finishes. Lowercased before use; anything that is not a uuid is refused, so nothing else can shape an object key.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Resolution as WIDTHxHEIGHT. Both sides must be divisible by 16 and between 256 and 3840, within a 1:3 to 3:1 aspect ratio and 3840x2160 pixels in total. Defaults to POSTCARD_SIZE.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Encoding of the stored image, which also decides the object extension: jpeg is stored as `.jpg`, png as `.png`. Defaults to POSTCARD_FORMAT. `webp` is deliberately absent: gpt-image-2 accepts it and answers with png bytes anyway.

200.description: The render could not be handed to a background activation, so it was drawn while the caller waited and is stored.

202.description: The request was validated and the render is running in the background. The normal answer. The body carries where the art will appear; poll that url until it answers. A `202` whose body carries an `activationId` and no `key` comes from the platform rather than the function, and means the render is running but was not acknowledged — the art still appears under the uuid that was asked for.

400.description: The arguments are malformed. No image was drawn.

422.description: OpenAI refused to draw the prompt.

429.description: OpenAI is rate limiting image generation.

500.description: Required configuration is missing, or anything unexpected.

502.description: OpenAI is unreachable, answered without image data, or the bucket refused the upload.

functionSecret.name: X-Require-Whisk-Auth
functionSecret.description: The shared secret declared as `webSecure` in project.yml.

AcceptedPostcard.description: The request was validated and handed to a background activation. The art is not stored yet.

status.description: Always `accepted`, so this answer is never mistaken for a stored postcard.

city.description: The city as it was asked for, trimmed.

country.description: The country the city was placed in.

continent.description: The continent the city was placed on.

uuid.description: The uuid the object will be named after, lowercased.

key.description: Object key the art will appear under, prefix included.

url.description: Where the art will be readable once it is stored. Poll this until it answers.

model.description: The OpenAI image model that drew it.

key.description: Object key inside the bucket, prefix included.

url.description: Where the stored postcard can be read, if the configured acl allows it.
